as_told.title: Wernher von Braun warned Carol Rosin of a planned alien invasion

plain: Wernher von Braun was a leading rocket scientist in the US space programme. Steven Greer, a guest who says UFO secrets are held by a hidden global group, says that von Braun, as he was dying, warned Greer's friend Carol Rosin that powerful people planned to invent an alien threat to unite the world. In another telling Greer calls it a "false flag," a staged threat blamed on someone else, and dates von Braun's death to 1974 rather than 1977. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions the same warning too, garbling Rosin's name. If true, a future "alien invasion" could be faked to win control over people.
